name: hematite
lore_descriptor: streaked deep red, the bloodstone metal
first_pickup_chronicle: Hematite. The bloodstone. Cold things shy from it; undead falter against it. The old healers swore by it before steel was understood.
design_notes: Fills pf 16 gap. Modest damage but anti-undead and cold-resistant. Magical-friendly (max_enchant 3) — the legends called it a soul-anchor metal.
